viewing_check: Check serial plate and that both needle beds are present (Duomatic 80 needs front and back bed, here the second bed looks like the long lower rail; confirm). Confirm Electra motor drive and Color changer are fitted and that the Electra powers up with the carriage moving (ask to test with power). Look for bent or missing needles, cracked plastic parts, rust on needle bed, carriage lock intact, and the presence of the Deco/E6 and cast-on/ribber accessories and manuals. Photograph serial and Electra panel.
